name: maodouchat-recovery-2025
description: Stabilize and modernize the Maodouchat client UI and core chat/backend reliability, validate locally, then commit/push and deploy to the explicitly provided Hong Kong server after verification.

members.name: ui-auditor
members.role: Audit and modernize client UI, duplicate switches, dark mode, sharing-link flows; inspect reference folders and implement scoped fixes.

members.name: chat-reliability
members.role: Investigate sender keys, decryption failures, message key crashes/repeats, notification sound; implement and test reliability fixes.

members.name: backend-stability
members.role: Audit backend management functions and stability, identify/fix high-impact issues, add focused tests.

members.name: qa-deploy
members.role: Inspect repository structure, local test/build/deploy setup, prepare verification and deployment plan; do not deploy until captain approval.

tasks.subject: Modernize client UI
tasks.description: Inspect the repository and reference folders for Murexide/Telegram. Audit duplicate switches, theme tokens, navigation, chat layout, sharing-link UI, and major unusable client flows. Implement the highest-impact UI fixes in your owned files, preserving concurrent work boundaries. Run focused checks and report changed files and remaining risks.
tasks.output: UI audit identified two concrete fixes (scrollable theme/language chip rows; move QR share chooser launch from IO to Main), but captain file-edit tools are unavailable because every write/edit/bash attempt is rejected as an invalid sandbox escalation while runtime is already danger-full-access. No files changed.

tasks.subject: Repair chat encryption
tasks.description: Trace sender-key provisioning, decrypt failures, message-key crash/repetition loops, and notification sound handling. Implement robust fixes with focused tests or diagnostics in owned files. Avoid broad UI rewrites; report exact behavior and verification.

tasks.subject: Stabilize backend flows
tasks.description: Audit backend management endpoints/services and runtime stability. Identify the most severe broken functions, implement scoped fixes and focused tests, and report any blockers. Avoid overlapping UI and crypto files unless required by a clear contract.
tasks.output: Audited backend management/runtime paths. Found high-impact defect: Admin PUT /api/admin/settings reports success and audits even when submitted keys are unknown because RuntimeConfigService.setMany silently filters them. Sent captain exact fix and focused test proposal. File edits/tests blocked by tool sandbox rejecting all write escalation in current danger-full-access context.

tasks.subject: Map QA and deployment
tasks.description: Inspect repo structure, package scripts, reference assets, local build/test commands, git remote/branch state, and deployment configuration. Produce a verification/deployment checklist and identify risks. Do not modify files or deploy yet.
tasks.output: Mapped repo and ops: root Android Compose Gradle project (Gradle 8.14.5/JDK21/compileSdk36), independent server Ktor Gradle project, npm Playwright E2Es, CI/release jobs, Docker Compose and maintenance scripts. Read-only git refs show main f01bac1e ahead of origin/main b486b694 by four local commits; origin remote is GitHub HTTPS and no Hong Kong target config exists. Reference assets are local gitignored material (Ideaura/Murexide/Telegram/blind_watermark). Sent captain complete verification/deployment checklist and risks: run CI-equivalent Gradle/server/Postgres/browser/compose/Caddy gates; target doctor + DNS/ports/secrets/SMTP-TURN checks; backup before update; health/live-ready/status/admin/WS/E2EE/attachments/calls smoke after deploy. Flagged release unsigned/temporary debug signing fallback, local-ahead remote risk, and backup --dry-run creating temporary backup directories despite read-only docs. No files modified or deployment performed.

tasks.subject: Integrate and deploy
tasks.description: After all audits and fixes complete, coordinate full local verification, resolve integration issues, prepare commit/push, and deploy only after captain confirms tests/build and target-server access.
